title: Domain-bridging incentive contract (L26)
description: 1.5x promotion-score bonus for cross-domain solvers. See ADR-050.

invariants.name: applied_at_promotion
invariants.description: Bonus modifies promotion-gate score, not runtime.

invariants.name: anti_cargo_cult_still_applies
invariants.description: Bonus does NOT bypass ADR-034 gate.
must: bridging solver still passes anti-cargo-cult probes

invariants.name: auditable
invariants.description: Promotion log includes bridging_indicator + domains list.

invariants.name: no_retroactive_boost
invariants.description: Promoted solver retains bonus; not recomputed.
must: bonus baked into stored solver record at promotion time
